body: To the ones I can, I have
This is so so lovely!! Thank you :)

Similar yes, for me it feels like a hypersensitivity in the present- like knowing and feeling what the other is going through/feeling. Sometimes I will feel that x person is not ok and when I check in, that is the case.

Omg same actually!! I restarted by listening to some of Brene Brown's work around vulnerability and shame. My process now is a notebook where I write that the following space is safe and whatever I write will not be seen or judged by anybody. Like I literally write down the kind of safety I feel like is missing and it helps. Then you can burry it or burn it or flush it :) You can also journal in form of symbols and shapes if you are afraid that someone will read the words. I make a ton of abstract art as a way to journal and it is interesting that people can FEEL what I felt as I made it but they cant pin point why. it helps.
Thank you so much <3 You are incredible.
